|gr1= Object Detection

|descr= Finds the nearest building to a given object or position. A "building" is defined as an object that is of class "House" and contains a path LOD.

|s1= [[nearestBuilding]] position

|p1= position: [[Object]] or [[Position#Introduction|Position2D]] or [[Position#PositionAGL|PositionAGL]]

|r1= [[Object]]

|x1= <sqf>_nBuilding = nearestBuilding player;</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>_nBuilding = nearestBuilding position player;</sqf>

|seealso= [[buildingPos]] [[nearestObject]] [[nearestObjects]] [[nearObjects]] [[nearestLocation]] [[nearEntities]] [[nearTargets]] [[nearSupplies]] [[nearestLocationWithDubbing]] [[nearObjectsReady]] [[nearRoads]] [[nearestMines]]
}}

{{Note
|user= Pierre MGI
|timestamp= 20160218201800
|text= This command doesn't return any house or building placed in editor (with [[createVehicle]]). Use [[nearestObjects]] instead:
<sqf>nearestObjects [player, ["House", "Building"], 50] select 0</sqf>
}}

{{Note
|user= Tankbuster
|timestamp= 20201230160400
|text= Some large buildings are not found by this command. "Land_Airport_Tower_F", "Land_Offices_01_V1_F" and "Land_Hotel_02_F" are examples.
}}
